title: crataegus monogyna var. semperflorens
intro: Crataegus monogyna var. semperflorens, commonly known as Evergreen Hawthorn, is a variety of hawthorn tree that retains its leaves year-round, unlike its deciduous counterpart. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including lowering blood pressure, reducing cholesterol levels, and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus monogyna var. semperflorens include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory effects, which contribute to its ability to protect against heart disease and other cardiovascular conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential in preventing or treating various health conditions.
